answer: Each head needs a credential no other head can rent: a fresh nonce countersigned by an institution that vouched for its principal, an OTP or a bank signature. A violet in one garden cannot drink another flower's nectar. The scarce per-head input is that vouched identity, not compute: a farm prints cores by the thousand, but an institution issues one countersignature per principal per epoch, so every extra head needs a new principal, each later one harder as reputation filters bite. Nonces burn with the epoch, so one credential cannot outfit two heads.
